name: detour
description: Work on your SSH servers through Detour without seeing a password or key. You approve each host and what is allowed there.
long_description:
Detour is an open-source SSH client. Its MCP server lets the AI work on your servers: run commands, read the terminal, edit files over SFTP, start tunnels. The AI never sees a password or key. It asks for the hosts and rights it needs and says why; you allow it in the Detour window for 2 hours, a day, a week or until you revoke it, and every command shows up there.

Install Detour from https://github.com/INotSleep/Detour/releases/latest for the window where you approve access. This extension uses the Detour installed on the computer and brings its own `detour` command line only for computers without it.
